result.title: Introducing Tools in Google Flow
result.description:
With Google Flow Tools, you can build creative workflows customized to fit your creative process. Explore a gallery of premade Tools built by creatives, remix existing ones to fit your needs, or create your own from scratch by just typing a description of what you want to create. You can shape and iterate on these Tools fluidly, adjusting them for individual projects, or singular clips and images. 

Build your own custom creative Tools at flow.google

result.title: Exploring Tools in Google Flow | In the Flow
result.description:
Introducing Google Flow Tools: a new way to create custom workflows and tools. All within Google Flow.

Tools in Google Flow lets you create bespoke creative workflows just by describing them. And if you create something you like, you can share your Tool with your friends or remix Tools created by others. We partnered with six creatives spanning a variety of industries to build custom Tools for you to explore, including Kat Zhang, MetaPuppet, and Chris Maestas. These can all be found within a larger gallery of Tools directly in Google Flow.

All Google Flow users are able to use existing Tools, while Google AI subscribers can also create and remix them.

Try Google Flow for yourself: https://flow.google/

result.title: Introducing your Agent and Gemini Omni in Google Flow
result.description:
Meet your new agent in Google Flow: your creative partner that can plan and reason through complex tasks with your inputs, all while under your direction. Built with Gemini models, it brings expertise and a deep understanding of your project to help with early brainstorming, creating and editing. Whether crafting dialogue or tweaking multiple creative assets at once, your agent is ready to help bring your visions to life.

Also introducing our Gemini Omni Flash model. It combines Gemini’s intelligence with our generative media models - and is a leap forward in world understanding, multimodality, and editing. For creatives using Google Flow, Omni Flash allows you to blend real-world inspiration with generated content and iterate conversationally. Omni Flash also improves character consistency, meaning identity and voice are preserved across every scene. 

This is your best creative work, unlocked. 

Try Google Flow for yourself: https://labs.google/fx/tools/flow
